ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; pixel data is dominated by low-intensity (black/dark grey) values with minimal high-intensity (white) pixel presence on the primary ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark pigmentation across both lobes; small, localized high-intensity (white) specks are sparsely mapped to the distal regions of the right lobe and the interior region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch; central vertex point defines an approximate 85-95 degree angle with a bounding-box depth approximately 1/8th of the fluke's vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits a high-frequency, low-amplitude serration pattern; peaks are most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes, transitioning to a smoother linear boundary near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave sweep fitted to the trailing edge, originating from the notch and curving upwards toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white pixel circularities detected at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions visible on the ventral surface of the right lobe, extending from the mid-section toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of high-intensity material (likely biological colonization) are present on the leading and trailing edges of the fluke tips.
